rows.note: Use 播放器 for either a physical device or a software application that plays audio or video.

example.english: This player can't play the video.
example.traditional: 呢個播放器播唔到條片。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 bo3 fong3 hei3 bo3 m4 dou2 tiu4 pin2

rows.note: For a person playing a sport, 運動員 is the all-purpose term rather than 播放器 or 玩家.

example.english: I want to be a player on the school team.
example.traditional: 我想做學校隊嘅運動員。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zou6 hok6 haau6 deoi6 ge3 wan6 dung6 jyun4

rows.note: Use 玩家 for a video-game player, or for a significant participant in an industry, field, or political arena; it is not the usual word for a sports player.

example.english: Each player in this game has their own way of playing.
example.traditional: 呢隻遊戲每個玩家都有自己嘅玩法。
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 jau4 hei3 mui5 go3 waan4 gaa1 dou1 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 waan4 faat3

rows.note: Use 演員 for someone performing an acting role in a play or other dramatic production.

example.english: One player in that play performed brilliantly.
example.traditional: 嗰套劇入面有個演員演得好出色。
example.jyutping: go2 tou3 kek6 jap6 min6 jau5 go3 jin2 jyun4 jin2 dak1 hou2 ceot1 sik1
